description: Aardgas- en elektriciteitslevering aan bedrijven; verbruiksklasse, SBI 2008 is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by CBS OpenData. Deze tabel bevat het aantal adressen van bedrijven en instellingen met tenminste één elektriciteits- en/of aardgasaansluiting op het openbare net in Nederland. Tevens is de totale levering van aardgas/elektriciteit aan deze adressen opgenomen. De gegevens zijn uitgesplitst naar bedrijfstak en verbruiksklasse. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher CBS OpenData. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ATOM, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON. The portal shows 2025-12-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
